context: A barista and a friend chat about playlists at the cafe
purpose: Teach: 歌詞/シングル/プレーヤー/オーディオ/放映/鑑賞/グレード/レンタル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵ちゃん、このカフェのオーディオ機器、すごくいい音だね。誰のプレイリスト?
lines.en: Aoi, this cafe's audio equipment sounds amazing. Whose playlist is this?
lines.style: Soft dreamy delivery, slightly breathy with admiring warmth

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私が選んでるの。お客さんに合わせて、グレードを変えてるんだ。
lines.en: I'm the one choosing. I adjust the grade depending on the customers.
lines.style: Friendly professional tone, calm confident with subtle pride

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今かかってる曲、歌詞がすごく綺麗。最近出たシングルかな?
lines.en: The lyrics of this song are so beautiful. Is it a recent single?
lines.style: Wistful curious voice, gentle rising intonation throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そう、先週テレビで放映されたドラマの主題歌だよ。すごく人気で。
lines.en: Yes, it's the theme song from a drama broadcast last week. Very popular.
lines.style: Informative cheerful tone, warm and conversational with steady pace

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私、家のCDプレーヤーが壊れちゃって。最近は配信で音楽鑑賞してるの。
lines.en: My CD player at home broke. Lately I just enjoy music through streaming.
lines.style: Softly nostalgic tone, slight sigh with reflective melancholy

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あー、わかる。私もたまにレンタルショップ行くけど、もう減ってきたよね。
lines.en: Ah, I get it. I still hit rental shops sometimes, but they're disappearing.
lines.style: Sympathetic relatable tone, casual easygoing with gentle laugh

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、葵ちゃんのおすすめプレイリスト、今度教えてくれない?
lines.en: Hey Aoi, will you share your recommended playlist with me sometime?
lines.style: Sweetly pleading tone, soft endearing with hopeful smile audible

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: もちろん!週末、ここで一緒に聴きながらコーヒー飲もうよ。
lines.en: Of course! Let's have coffee here together this weekend and listen.
lines.style: Bright warm invitation, energetic friendly with welcoming uplift
